claim.claim-text: 1. A computer-implemented method when executed on data processing hardware causes the data processing hardware to perform operations comprising:
sending information to the second computing device that causes the second computing device to:

call the corresponding telephone number of the most relevant search result automatically; and present a user interface element that, when selected with user input, causes a cancelation of the automatic calling of the telephone number.

2. The method of claim 1, wherein the information sent to the second computing device causes the second computing device to call the corresponding telephone number without any additional inputs from the user after the first computing device records the audio corresponding to the query.
3. The method of any preceding claim, wherein the first computing device records the audio corresponding to the query using a microphone of the first computing device.
4. The method of any preceding claim, wherein the query comprises a carrier phrase that includes the word "call".
5. The method of any preceding claim, wherein the query comprises a carrier phrase that includes the word "phone".
6. The method of any preceding claim, wherein the second computing device comprises a mobile computing device.
7. The method of any preceding claim, wherein the second computing device is configured to display the most relevant search result on a screen of the second computing device.

8. The method of any preceding claim, wherein determining, based on the textual representation of the query, that the query is of the type that is to cause the second computing device of the user to call the corresponding telephone number of the most relevant search result automatically comprises determining that the textual representation of the query includes a carrier phrase that identifies that the query is for causing the second computing device to call the corresponding telephone number automatically.
9. The method of any preceding claim, wherein the data processing hardware resides on a remote server system in communication with the second computing device.

10. The method of any preceding claim, wherein the second computing device is configured to dial the corresponding telephone number of the most relevant search result without receipt of user input that selects the corresponding number for dialing.

data processing hardware; and memory hardware in communication with the data processing hardware and storing instructions when executed on the data processing hardware cause the data processing hardware to perform operations comprising the method of any preceding claim.
